Hyundai Bayon SUV to Launch with Advanced Safety Features on Oct 26

Hyundai is set to launch its new Bayon SUV on October 26, with the company revealing that the model will include Level 2 advanced driver‑assistance (ADAS), six airbags, a suite of 35 safety features and a 23‑function ADAS system, and will be offered in ten colour options.
